acceptance: Native CPU torque/contact checks unchanged; select on development physical effects and stability, then freeze before heldout. GPU rewards alone cannot promote.
stop: Stop on sustained nonfinite training, export mismatch, repeated CPU physical rejection or budget; record all stopped/rejected runs.
source_priors: Contact ONNX is a verified initialization with a fresh 85D critic and cleared optimizer state, not a faithful resume of its original training.
actors: 61D observations, 14 unfiltered joint targets, 50 Hz. Two 0.73724318 kg robots with matched capped PD and separate native collision layers. Critic alone has 85 privileged features.
version2: After actual target exit, request zero motor command and require 0.30 s supported stable braking before one-shot goal and termination. Initial exploration std .06; same deterministic contact actor and fresh critic.

stopped_v1.reason: Found that immediate target-exit termination never teaches post-exit braking; preserve short run, restart from original verified actor rather than promoting it.

stopped_v2.reason: 50 and 100 CPU courses regressed supported finishing and falls; restructure invisible-edge coach, preserving original training and all rejected candidates.
